spacing.none.description: Intentional zero spacing. Collapsing gaps, removing default padding on reset elements.

spacing.xxs.description: Micro adjustments. Notification badge offset, indicator dot position, tight icon nudges.

spacing.xs.description: Icon-to-label gap, tag/badge internal padding, tight chip spacing, button icon gap.

spacing.sm.description: Status pill padding, pagination item padding, vertical tab padding, small control gaps.

spacing.md.description: Table cell padding, button group gap, modal inner gap, list row vertical padding, tooltip padding.

spacing.lg.description: Tab button vertical padding, accordion header padding, form label gap, link group gap.

spacing.xl.description: Tab button horizontal padding, button large padding, notification padding, table cell horizontal padding, form field label gap.

spacing.2xl.description: Button large horizontal padding, section subgroup spacing, comfortable list gaps on tablet.

spacing.3xl.description: Modal padding, card padding, notification horizontal padding, accordion medium gap.

spacing.4xl.description: Section padding, section gap, card lg/md/sm padding on web. Major layout rhythm value.

spacing.5xl.description: Page content top padding, large drawer padding, between-section vertical rhythm on web.

spacing.6xl.description: Accordion medium header gap, large section separators, major vertical rhythm breaks.

spacing.7xl.description: Page header bottom margin, switch description offset, large structural gaps on web.

spacing.8xl.description: Large layout offsets, page-level container padding on wide breakpoints.

spacing.9xl.description: Maximum semantic spacing. Wide-screen page container horizontal padding.

spacing.10xl.description: Radio description indent, structural layout offsets in complex dashboard layouts.

spacing.11xl.description: Maximum layout structural offset. Rare — use only for intentional large structural gaps.

radius.md.description: Input, select, small popover, default button.

radius.full.description: Pill and circle: avatar, toggle track, count badge.

border.focus.offset.description: Gap between control and focus ring.

size.control.height.lg.description: Default on tablet and mobile (= touch target).

motion.duration.xs.description: Ripple start, color change on small controls.

motion.duration.md.description: Tooltip, menu open, expand small content.

motion.duration.progress.description: One turn of a looping progress indicator (spinner). NOT reduced to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion — progress indicators are the allowed exception (motion.md).

motion.easing.standard.description: Default for elements that stay on screen.
